entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit support, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac. I'm calling about the VeloBand Pulse I bought a couple of weeks ago. I'd like to see about returning it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I get your name and the order number?
Sure, the name is Alex Chen, and the order number is VF789012.

Thank you, Alex. I see the order here for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on January 13th. Before we go into the return options, can I ask what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's definitely a preference thing. To be honest, I just find the interface a bit confusing. The user manual wasn't very clear, and some of the features are just hard to use. I really expected more for the price.
I understand. Sometimes new devices can have a bit of a learning curve. I could walk you through setting up some custom shortcuts if you'd like?

I appreciate that, but I think I've made up my mind. I know I'm just past the 10-day mark, so if a full refund isn't possible, would you consider a partial store credit? Maybe a discount code for a future purchase? I'm trying to find a fair solution here.

Let me just pull up our official policy for you, one moment... Okay, I've got it here. Alex, it looks like you have nothing to worry about. Our knowledge base shows that all VeloFit items are eligible for a full refund within 90 days of delivery.
Oh, 90 days? That's fantastic. I must have misread the policy on the new product page. I was prepared to negotiate.

Not a problem at all. Since your delivery was on January 13th, you are well within that timeframe. I can go ahead and process this return for you right now. I'll email you a pre-paid shipping label. You'll just need to print it, attach it to the original box, and drop it off.
That's perfect. Much easier than I expected. Thank you, Isaac.

You're very welcome, Alex. The email with the label is on its way. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that's everything. Thanks for your help.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
